'''Stanisław Ruziewicz''' (29 August 1889 – 12 July 1941) was a Polish [[mathematician]] and one of the founders of the [[Lwów School of Mathematics]].

He was a former student of [[Wacław Sierpiński]], earning his doctorate in 1913 from the [[Lviv University|University of Lwów]]; his thesis concerned [[continuous function]]s that are not [[Differentiable function|differentiable]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy |id=123308}}</ref> He became a professor at the same university (then named Jan Kazimierz University) and [[Rector (academia)|rector]] of the [[Academy of Foreign Trade in Lwów]].<ref>{{Citation |last=Rossowski |first=Stanisław (1861-1940) Red |title=Gazeta Lwowska. 1932, nr 128 |date=1932-06-08 |url=https://jbc.bj.uj.edu.pl/dlibra/plain-content?id=34547 |access-date=2022-07-20}}</ref> During the [[Second World War]], Ruziewicz's home city of [[Lwów]] was annexed by the 
[[Ukrainian Soviet Socialist Republic]], but then taken over by the [[General Government]] of [[Occupation of Poland (1939–1945)|German-occupied Poland]] in July 1941; Ruziewicz was arrested and murdered by the [[Gestapo]] on 12 July 1941 in Lwów, during the [[Massacre of Lviv professors|Massacre of Lwów professors]].<ref>[[Wacław Sierpiński]], as quoted in {{citation
 | last = Rotkiewicz | first = A.
 | doi = 10.1007/BF02844227
 | journal = [[Rendiconti del Circolo Matematico di Palermo]] | series = Serie II
 | mr = 0323676
 | pages = 5–24
 | title = W. Sierpiński's works on the theory of numbers
 | volume = 21
 | year = 1972| issue = 1–2
 }}: "In  July  1941  one of  my  oldest  students  Stanislaw  Ruziewicz  was  murdered.  He  was  a  retired full  professor  of  Jan  Kazimierz  University  in  Lvov,  the  last  rector  of  Foreign Trade  Academy  in  Lvov,  an  outstanding  mathematician  and  an  excellent  teacher."</ref>

The [[Ruziewicz problem]], asking whether the [[Lebesgue measure]] on the sphere may be characterized by certain of its properties, is named after him.<ref>{{citation
 | last = [[Alexander Lubotzky|Lubotzky]] | first = Alexander
 | contribution = 2 The Banach–Ruziewicz Problem
 | location = Basel
 | pages = 7–18
 | publisher = Birkhäuser Verlag
 | series = Modern Birkhäuser Classics
 | title = Discrete Groups, Expanding Graphs and Invariant Measures
 | year = 2010}}.</ref>
